- Overestimate prices when sentiment is positive (especially >0.0) and understate when sentiment is negative (especially < -0.3).  
- Overshoot after recent price spikes; reduce forecast peak by 5–10% if sentiment is neutral or slightly negative.  
- Lag in downward corrections: if true price drops after a spike, forecast should adjust earlier if sentiment turns negative.  
- Mean-reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive days show high sentiment + high price, forecast should slightly lower next period’s peak.  
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate early in the cycle when sentiment is volatile; reduce by 2–5% if sentiment swings >0.3 in last 3 days.
